cues: The whole essay has the shape of an hourglass.
The introduction narrows: a general opening, then the issue, then the thesis, in fifty or sixty words.
The body is the straight part and the longest, two hundred to two hundred and sixty words: a paragraph for each reason, and one for the other side, answered.
The conclusion widens back out: the position restated in new words, what follows from it, and a last line worth remembering.
